page.overview:
Who is Trixie Gadgets?

is a generosity unicorn. She was played by Markeia McCarty in .

Trixie is a unicorn with a blue coat, golden eyes and a kinky yellow and white mane. Her cutie mark is three golden cogs over a pale blue shape. She wears inventor goggles and a belt bag that carries all sorts of items.

Trixie loves inventing the best gadgets ever. She really wants to be a caped crusader superpony and help everybody.
